outcome: Unanticipated procedures to treat postpartum bleeding
cohort: Women with postpartum hemorrhage (estimated blood loss >500 mL for vaginal delivery and >1000 mL for cesarean delivery) at a single institution
finding: Despite an increased PPH rate, simulation education was associated with a reduction in hemorrhage-related maternal composite morbidity.
mod_finding: While this study adjusted for mode of delivery in its analysis, it did not report any findings specifically related to mode of delivery.
